CAUSE CALLED FOR COURT TRIAL. PL. PRESENT W/SUSAN PARKINSON AS COUNSEL. DEF. PRESENT W/SUSAN KAN AS COUNSEL. SETTLED BY STIP. W/JUDGMENT FOR PL. - RESTITUTION OF PREMISES AT 2730 16TH ST, S.F, CA. - $27,000 RENT & DAMAGES TO BE PAID IN THE FOLLOWING MANNER: $9,000 TO BE PD. 8-2-93 5PM AT THE OFFICE OF WEIGER & FREID, $6,000 TO BE PD. 8-22-93 5PM, $6,000 TO BE PD. 9-1-93 5PM, $6,000 TO BE PD. 9-15-93 5PM - THERE WILL BE A NEW 6MO LEASE W/$6,000 RENT PER MO. STARTING 10-1-93 & A 6MO. RENEWAL OPTION - DEF MUST OBTAIN $1,500,000 LIABILITY INSURANCE & PROVIDE CERTIFICATE TO PL. BY 8-16-93 DEF. AGREES TO PAY WATER BILL BY 8-9-93. RESTITUTION OF PREMISES IS STAYED CONDITIONED UPON COMPLIANCE W/THE ABOVE STATED TERMS. PL. ATTY. TO PREPARE JUDGMENT.

THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT ZAHRIYA, JIMMY THE RESTITUTION AND POSSESSION OF THE PREMISES: 2730 16TH ST, S.F, CA. $27,000.00 RENT, TOTAL JUDGMENT $27,000.00, LEASE FORFEITED, SCHEDULED PMTS TO BE COMPLETED BY 9-15-93. EACH SIDE BEARS THEIR COSTS & ATTY FEES. SEE FILE FOR JUDGMENT DETAILS.
